header: ROUND 12 - Real Repo: pallets/click #2819 - a parameter named 'help' breaks parsing

verdict_notes: The hardest real-repo round - the maintainers' fix reserves '_click_default_help' unconditionally, which neither model guessed. Sol's +23-line fix solved the actual reported collisions (user option/argument/custom-flags named 'help' all parse) lifting 2/11 to 5/11. Opus's rename-on-collision approach compiled but moved nothing: still 2/11, the buggy-base score. Sol wins on tests despite being 2.3x slower.
